description: Use this to check one generation job by generation_id: its status, credits and, when it failed, a safe error_message. A brief's runs are read with mcp_brief_runs. Changes nothing.

inputSchema.description: Input schema for checking generation status.

generation_id.description: The generation ID to check. Returns compact status, avatar_id, model_id, model_slug, and use_case. UI 'Gemini Pro' maps to model_slug nano-banana-pro or nano_banana_pro_clothing.

include_snapshot.description: Include full generation settings, resource snapshots and raw prompt payloads. Large; use only for prompt recovery.

name: get_generation_status
title: Generation Status
